title: Vantage managed configuration
description: Any key set here overrides the user's choice and is greyed out in Settings. Deploy via Edge/Chrome 3rd-party extension policy (ExtensionSettings or ExtensionInstallForcelist + 3rdparty/extensions/<id>/policy).

domScope.title: How much of the page the content script may read
domScope.description: minimal (default): the composer only. Response timing comes from mutation events, copy-out from the copy event, account tier from the plan badge. standard: additionally reads response text, the selection, and the account-menu address. Pin this to minimal unless you have a specific reason.

allowFullText.title: Permit the 'full' capture level to be selected

retentionDays.title: Days of history retained on the device

showCaptureToast.title: Show the on-page capture confirmation
showCaptureToast.description: Recommended true. Staff should be able to see that a prompt was logged.

disabledSites.title: Adapter ids that must not be captured

surfaces.title: Which part of the platform a prompt went to

idFrom.description: e.g. url:1 — the capture group holding the agent id

extraTaxonomyTerms.title: Extra keyword weights per work category
extraTaxonomyTerms.description: Object keyed by category id. Chrome's policy schema cannot express mixed-type tuples, so terms are objects: [{"term": "board paper", "weight": 6}].

reportEmailTo.title: Default recipient for the Email report button

weekStartsOn.title: First day of the reporting week (0 Sunday, 1 Monday)

policyAdapters.title: Site configuration pushed from central
policyAdapters.description: Same shape as customAdapters. These win over anything the user added and are locked in the UI. This is the channel your existing enterprise update tooling should write to.

surfaces.title: Which part of the platform a prompt went to

idFrom.description: e.g. url:1 — the capture group holding the agent id

siteConfigVersion.title: Stamp for the pushed site config, shown in Settings

valueSurveyEnabled.title: Ask the point-of-use time-saved question
valueSurveyEnabled.description: The only field that can support a time-saved claim. User-facing: needs sign-off before enabling.

valueSurveySamplePercent.title: Percent of eligible moments that ask
valueSurveySamplePercent.description: Integer 1-100. Chrome's policy schema does not accept fractional number properties.

orgUnit.title: Business unit name stamped on every report

orgDivision.title: Division / department, if your push can target groups

orgDomainMap.title: Email domain to business unit name
orgDomainMap.description: One map pushed to every business unit. Each device resolves its own business unit from the signed-in profile domain, so a single uniform push still produces per business unit reporting.

corporateDomains.title: Domains counted as corporate accounts
corporateDomains.description: Used to tell an enterprise AI account from a personal one. Defaults to the keys of orgDomainMap.

deriveIdentity.title: Allow deriving business unit from the signed-in profile domain
deriveIdentity.description: Requires the optional identity.email permission. Only the domain and a salted hash are kept; the address is discarded.

reportSigningKey.title: Key used to mark exported reports
reportSigningKey.description: Push one key org-wide so a single verifier can check reports from every device. Anyone holding it can verify a report — and can also produce one that passes — so treat it as a secret. Without it each device signs with its own generated key.

uploadEnabled.title: Send finished reports to an internal endpoint
uploadEnabled.description: Off by default. This and every other upload key can ONLY be set here — the extension refuses to change them from its own UI, so a user cannot enable or redirect uploads.

uploadUrl.title: HTTPS endpoint that receives the POST
uploadUrl.description: Where each report is written. May contain the placeholders {device}, {unit}, {period} and {date}, which are substituted per upload so each period lands at its own object rather than overwriting the last. A presigned or SAS query string is preserved. The extension also needs host permission for this origin, either in host_permissions in an internally packaged build or through the ExtensionSettings policy runtime_allowed_hosts.

uploadMethod.title: HTTP method used to write
uploadMethod.description: PUT for object storage, which is the default. POST if you are pointing at a receiver that expects it.

uploadHeaders.title: Extra request headers
uploadHeaders.description: Needed by some object stores. Azure Blob requires x-ms-blob-type set to BlockBlob.

uploadAuthHeader.title: Value sent verbatim as the Authorization header
uploadAuthHeader.description: Sent verbatim as the Authorization header. Leave empty when the URL is already presigned, because sending both causes some object stores to reject the request.

uploadCadence.title: How often a completed period is sent

uploadContent.title: What each upload contains
uploadContent.description: summary: the written narrative and headline numbers. aggregate (default): the full report object — counts and rates, no prompt text. events: every captured event row.

uploadIncludePromptText.title: Include redacted prompt text in event uploads
uploadIncludePromptText.description: Only has an effect when uploadContent is 'events'. Redacted text still leaves the device. Requires a privacy assessment before enabling.
